product.title: Tanah Lot and North Bali Tour: Scenic Journey

description.text: In Bali, this private eight-to-ten-hour north-and-west day leaves a hotel in Ubud or south Bali for Ulun Danu Bratan Temple on Lake Beratan, photo stops at Buyan Lake and Tamblingan Lake, a swim window at Banyumala Twin Waterfalls, lunch-scale views at UNESCO-listed Jatiluwih Green Land, and a late stop at Pura Batu Bolong and Tanah Lot Temple. A driver-guide, air-conditioned van, parking, entrance fees, and bottled water are listed. The format suits visitors who want a guided water-temple and rice-terrace circuit without self-driving the Bedugul and Jatiluwih roads. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Bali, and the itinerary stays on Ulun Danu Bratan, Banyumala, Jatiluwih, and Tanah Lot that define this outing rather than an Ubud Monkey Forest loop.
